name: Kotab
description: Kotab was a planet located in the Kotab system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The world was one of the homeworlds of the sentient Kotabi bond-twins Ceret and Terec, alongside the planet Sagamore where the twins originated from.
